queries.text: Series title follows the glossary proposal "Man’s Suffering in Love" (O Sofrimento Amoroso do Homem), as in the other volumes.
Title "O Profano Feminino" → "The Profane Feminine" (glossary, config title_en); it echoes, by contrast, the "Sacred Feminine."

Subtitle "Considerações sobre uma Face da Mulher que Ninguém quer Encarar". "Considerações" → "Reflections"; alternatives: "Considerations on a Face of Woman No One Wants to Face", "Thoughts on a Side of Women Nobody Wants to Confront".

The citation gives the English titles; the Portuguese originals are "O Profano Feminino: Considerações sobre uma Face da Mulher que Ninguém Quer Encarar" and "O Sofrimento Amoroso do Homem - Vol. II".

The author’s notice explicitly forbids translating the book and any alteration of its "language or title". Translated faithfully; a human must confirm that this English edition is authorized before publication (as for the other volumes).

The table of contents reads "Como elas minam a desconfiança" (How they undermine distrust), but the chapter heading itself is "O enfraquecimento das desconfianças" (The weakening of suspicions). Both kept as in the original.
